findings: RANK IS NOT CONTRACT (NEW law; the exploration ladder UPGRADED): the structural layer answers 'where might it be' (BM25-ranked candidates), never 'this is it'. Three wired episodes show one failure family: D decoyed to a different FILE (key-verify.mjs — similar words, different desk), E2 took the TOP-RANK neighborhood (rpc@46-59) instead of the contract function (chainPubkeys@68-78). The ladder law gains a MANDATORY confirmation rung: query structure FIRST -> CONFIRM each candidate against the QUESTION's full contract (short read) -> read only to confirm. Semantic similarity is a candidate generator, not an answer authority — this maps onto the fleet's verify-only adoption doctrine and anti-Goodhart law.

TURN ECONOMY IS TASK-SHAPE BOUNDED (honest bound on R5/R7): paired N=2 shows the governed host does NOT reduce turns on this sample (single-symbol 6->7; discovery 14->16; remedy 8 vs raw 14). The R5 (7->3) and R7 (6->3) multipliers were wins where the tool compressed exploration of LARGE surfaces; on single-symbol lookups grep is one turn away. The wiring's PROVEN economies are LATENCY (9 structural queries ~0.1s vs ~49.5s one-shot-CLI equivalent; whole wired episode 15.1s wall) and GOVERNANCE (policy + deny receipts + per-call dt in one place) — turn count is task-shape dependent and must be measured per task class, never assumed.

HOST-CONSUMER WIRING LAW (proven in both directions): consumers ride the host through ONE wrapper contract (agents/cmmq/cmmq.sh); consumption from INSIDE a guarded episode is receipted host-side per call; denies through the same wrapper are fail-loud rc=1 + JSONL; the wrapper itself carries zero policy surface (reads-only client) so the host remains the single policy point. Any future consumer (mini-swe system prompts, reef harnesses, Graft, gateway browser clients) inherits this shape — the CR-0031 consumer-contract finding is now executable and receipted.

FRESHNESS AT CONSUMPTION TIME (NEW discipline): detect_changes through the wrapper measured index drift from inside the consumption flow (merge_base 3d65c7b; changed = this rung's own uncommitted wrapper — a self-referential precision hit). Index freshness is a receipted measurement, not an assumption; reindex stays owner-gated (the write quartet is invisible to the analysis profile BY POLICY — a consumer that could reindex would be a consumer that could mutate the graph).

STORM CAPACITY (re-receipted): the unbounded broad-scope episode outlasted 540s in an upstream-latency window; the narrowed confirmed-scope retry finished in 15.1s with zero 429 retry markers (the CR-0026 queue absorbed variance invisibly). Law: episode scope is a capacity decision — broad discovery episodes get cron-class patience windows; confirmed-scope episodes fit interactive windows.

MEASUREMENT HYGIENE (small, honest): wall-time for G9-A was lost to a missing bc(1) in the measurement shell — turn count from trajectory JSONs is the primary metric; python3 timestamps used thereafter. The paired matrix is N=2 pairs + 1 remedy variant: directional, not statistical; booked as bounds, not laws of nature.
